en_title: Call of Duty Movie Director Teases Story That Explores 'the Cost of War,' Praises Modern Warfare Characters
cn_title: 《使命召唤》电影将探讨战争代价
subtitle: 战争留下的重担
opus_summary: 《使命召唤》真人电影导演Peter Berg表示，影片将聚焦《现代战争》的复杂角色与战争代价。电影定于2028年6月30日上映，更多剧情和演员信息尚未公布。

paragraphs.en: Call of Duty movie director Peter Berg has teased more details from his live-action film, promising an adaptation with "a very strong soul" that explores "the cost of war."
paragraphs.cn: 《使命召唤》电影导演Peter Berg透露了这部真人电影的更多细节，并承诺改编作品将拥有「非常强大的灵魂」，探讨「战争的代价」。

paragraphs.en: The filmmaker behind Skydance-Paramount's upcoming reimagining of Activision's massive first-person shooter series dived into his thoughts on the franchise during an interview with ComicBook . We already know the Call of Duty movie will focus on the Modern Warfare portion of the FPS universe , and it sounds like Berg and writer Taylor Sheridan have already looked to the games it's based on for inspiration.
paragraphs.cn: 在接受ComicBook采访时，这位负责Skydance与Paramount即将推出的Activision大型第一人称射击系列重制版的电影人，深入谈到了自己对这一系列的看法。我们已经知道，《使命召唤》电影将聚焦FPS宇宙中的《现代战争》部分，而从目前的说法来看，Berg和编剧Taylor Sheridan似乎已经从作为改编基础的游戏中寻找灵感。

paragraphs.en: "So Modern Warfare, if you really look at the missions, and the storylines, and the characters – like Captain Price, and Soap, and Ghost, and Alex – these are complicated humans," Berg said. "These are not – and no disrespect – cartoon characters or comic books. These are very nuanced storylines; like, there's a real soul to the Modern Warfare universe…
paragraphs.cn: Berg说道：「所以，如果你真正去审视《现代战争》中的任务、剧情和角色，比如普莱斯上尉、肥皂、幽灵以及Alex，就会发现他们都是复杂的人类角色。这些角色并不是——无意冒犯——卡通人物或漫画角色。这些剧情非常细腻；《现代战争》宇宙确实拥有真正的灵魂……」

paragraphs.en: "And, yes, there's violence, and there's hardware, and equipment, and there's killing – but underneath it I think the game, and the craters of the game, are really looking at the cost of war, the cost of having to be a warrior who's, for whatever reason, chosen to put himself between real danger and the rest of us, and the burden that these guys carry."
paragraphs.cn: 「没错，游戏中有暴力、有武器装备，也有杀戮。但我认为，在这些表象之下，游戏以及游戏留下的弹坑，真正关注的是战争的代价：成为一名战士的代价。无论出于什么原因，他们选择站在真正的危险与我们其他人之间，也因此背负了沉重的负担。」

paragraphs.en: Berg seems to be putting in the work to nail a Modern Warfare story for the big screen, but not every fan is convinced that he's the right guy for the job . That's mostly because he had some not-so-nice things to say about gaming back in 2013. When asked for his take on video games based on war at the time, he said, called them "pathetic," using the term, "keyboard courage."
paragraphs.cn: Berg似乎正努力为大银幕打造一个出色的《现代战争》故事，但并非所有粉丝都相信他适合担任这项工作。这主要是因为他在2013年曾对游戏说过一些不太友善的话。当时有人问他对战争题材电子游戏的看法，他称这类游戏「可悲」，还使用了「键盘勇气」一词。

paragraphs.en: "I think anyone that sits around playing video games for four hours... It's weak," Berg elaborated at the time. "Get out, do something."
paragraphs.cn: Berg当时进一步说道：「我认为，任何坐在那里玩四个小时电子游戏的人……都很软弱。出去做点什么吧。」

paragraphs.en: These days he's changed his tune, and judging by his affection for characters like Captain Price and Ghost, he's hoping to do right by Modern Warfare and its fans. His upcoming film, The Mosquito Bowl, is a sports-war film set to premiere later this month. His vision for the Call of Duty movie will start to take shape after that.
paragraphs.cn: 如今，Berg的态度已经改变。从他对普莱斯上尉和幽灵等角色的喜爱来看，他希望以正确的方式呈现《现代战争》及其粉丝。其即将上映的电影《The Mosquito Bowl》是一部体育战争题材影片，计划于本月晚些时候首映。在那之后，他对《使命召唤》电影的构想将开始成形。

paragraphs.en: "And that’s real stuff," Berg added when talking about Modern Warfare's connection to the real-life cost of war. "This is not just 'Hey, let’s shoot them all up and shoot popcorn!' Like, there’s a soul underneath it, that I understand that Taylor Sheridan understands, and I think probably not quite as graphically violent as Mosquito Bowl, but there will be a very strong soul, and consequence of war within the film, called 'duty.'"
paragraphs.cn: 谈到《现代战争》与现实战争代价之间的联系时，Berg补充道：「这些都是真实的东西。这不只是‘嘿，把他们全都射杀，然后看场爆米花电影！’之类的内容。它的底层有一种灵魂，我理解这一点，Taylor Sheridan也理解。我认为，电影中的画面暴力程度可能不会像《The Mosquito Bowl》那样，但其中会有非常强烈的灵魂，也会呈现战争的后果，而这部电影的名字就叫《使命召唤》。」

paragraphs.en: The Modern Warfare universe most recently expanded with the release of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 , which concluded Activision and Infinity Ward's reboot story when it launched yesterday. Its story has been called one of the darker entries the franchise has offered in recent memory.
paragraphs.cn: 《现代战争》宇宙最近随着《使命召唤：现代战争4》的发售而扩展。这款游戏于昨日推出，并为Activision和Infinity Ward重启的故事画上句号。其剧情被称为该系列近年来最黑暗的篇章之一。

paragraphs.en: The Call of Duty movie, meanwhile, is set to come to theaters June 30, 2028. Additional plot details have not been revealed, though fans have already been busy sharing their hopes for who may play familiar (and unconfirmed) characters like Captain Price, Ghost, and more. It's a year that seems set to be big for video game adaptations, with an Elden Ring film also set to release a few months prior. A Battlefield movie is also in the works .
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，《使命召唤》电影计划于2028年6月30日上映。影片尚未公布更多剧情细节，但粉丝已经开始热烈讨论，希望由谁出演普莱斯上尉、幽灵等熟悉但尚未确认的角色。2028年似乎将成为电子游戏改编作品的重要年份，因为《艾尔登法环》电影也计划在几个月前上映。此外，《战地》电影也在制作中。
